## Profile

I am an **M.Sc. student in Management and Digital Technology at the Technical University of Munich (TUM), Campus Heilbronn**, with five years of professional experience across **data analytics, process automation, digital business systems, and finance**.

My hands-on experience includes **Python, SQL, Power BI, JavaScript, REST APIs, UAT, SAP, and workflow automation**, supported by applied projects in **machine learning, LLM applications, and cloud optimization**.

My focus is using **data, automation, and technical tools to simplify complex business processes, improve system reliability, and create measurable impact**.
